description: Header file for the zhal (Zigbee Hardware Abstraction Layer) private implementations, including function declarations and include directives.

methods.name: zhalHandleEvent
methods.description: Handles a zhal event based on the provided JSON event object.

methods.name: zhalSendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to a target identified by an EUI64 address, with a JSON request payload and specified timeout.

methods.name: getCallbacks
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the zhal callbacks structure.

methods.name: getCallbackContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context associated with the callbacks.
